manifest.source: Baseball Savant official custom leaderboard CSV
manifest.scope: MLB, 2015–2026, 100+ PA. Model trained on qualified-PA proxy only (502 PA; 186 in 2020).
limitations: wRC+ unavailable; raw wOBA is not park/league adjusted
Not a causal model or a future MLB-success probability
2026 data reflect source snapshot; no automatic refresh
50% conditional frontier is a visualization convention, not a prospect threshold

model.supportRule: Within the four-metric development convex hull and at least 25 training seasons within ±5pp Chase/Whiff/Hard-Hit and ±3pp Barrel. Exploratory display guard, not validated uncertainty.
